pull_request.title: feat: add lint for inefficient Bytes concatenation
pull_request.body:
Closes #51

## Summary

Adds a new lint `soroban_inefficient_bytes_concat` that detects Bytes concatenation operations (`push_back` and `append`) executed inside loop bodies. Every mutation on Soroban `Bytes` crosses the host boundary, making per-iteration calls expensive in CPU instructions and transaction fees.

## Motivation

Soroban `Bytes` is a host-side object — each `push_back(val)` or `append(&other)` call invokes a host function. Placing these in a loop body wastes CPU instructions. The efficient approach is to accumulate bytes in a Rust `Vec<u8>` (cheap, local operations) and convert to `Bytes` once outside the loop via `Bytes::from_slice`.

```rust
// Bad: host call per iteration
let mut bytes = Bytes::new(&env);
for i in 0..items.len() {
    bytes.push_back(items[i]); // host call each iteration!
}

// Good: build in memory, convert once
let mut v: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
for i in 0..items.len() {
    v.push(items[i]); // cheap Rust operation
}
let bytes = Bytes::from_slice(&env, &v); // single host call
```

## Implementation Approach

Follows the exact same pattern as the existing `soroban_storage_in_loop` lint:

- Uses `check_expr` with `hir::ExprKind::MethodCall` pattern matching
- Checks method name is `push_back` or `append`
- Verifies the receiver type is `soroban_sdk::Bytes` (or `soroban_sdk::bytes::Bytes`) via `match_soroban_def_path`
- Uses `get_enclosing_loop_or_multi_call_closure` to detect loop context
- Fires `span_lint_and_help` with actionable guidance to use `Vec<u8>` + `Bytes::from_slice`

Categorized under `LintCategory::Compute` since Bytes host function calls are a CPU cost concern.

## Files Changed

| File | Changes |
|------|---------|
| `soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs` | +39 lines — Added lint declaration, struct, `impl_lint_pass!`, `check_expr` implementation, registration in `register_lints` and `LINT_METADATA` |
| `soroban_cost_lints/ui/main.rs` | +50 lines — Added `Bytes` mock type with `push_back` and `append`, plus 7 test fixtures covering for-loop, while-loop, `loop {}`, outside-loop, `Vec<u8>` alternative, and `#[allow]` |
| `soroban_cost_lints/ui/main.stderr` | +29/-1 lines — Added 4 new warnings, bumping total from 11 → 15 |
| `soroban_cost_lints/test_fixtures/real_sdk/src/lib.rs` | +25 lines — Added 4 real SDK fixtures: `push_back` in loop, `append` in loop, outside-loop, and `Vec<u8>` alternative |
| `cargo-cost-lint/tests/integration.rs` | +8 lines — Added assertion verifying `soroban_inefficient_bytes_concat` appears in JSON output |
| `docs/lints/README.md` | +1 line — Added new lint to the CPU/Compute table |
| `docs/lints/soroban_inefficient_bytes_concat.md` | New file — Documentation with description, examples, suggested fix, and scope |

## Test Coverage

**UI tests** (`soroban_cost_lints/ui/`):
- `bad_bytes_push_back_in_loop` — `push_back` in a `for` loop (should warn)
- `bad_bytes_append_in_loop` — `append` in a `for` loop (should warn)
- `bad_bytes_push_back_in_while` — `push_back` in a `while` loop (should warn)
- `bad_bytes_append_in_loop_loop` — `append` in a `loop {}` (should warn)
- `good_bytes_concat_outside_loop` — `push_back` outside loop (should not warn)
- `good_vec_build_then_convert` — `Vec<u8>` push in loop (should not warn — not Bytes)
- `allowed_bytes_concat_in_loop` — `#[allow]` suppresses the lint

**Integration tests** (`cargo-cost-lint/tests/`):
- Updated `test_json_output` to verify `soroban_inefficient_bytes_concat` in `--format json`

**Real SDK fixtures** (`soroban_cost_lints/test_fixtures/real_sdk/`):
- 4 fixtures exercising `soroban_sdk::Bytes::new`, `push_back`, `append`, `from_slice` with real SDK types

## Checklist

- [x] Implementation follows existing lint patterns (declare_lint!, impl_lint_pass!, LateLintPass)
- [x] Lint registered in both `register_lints` and `LINT_METADATA`
- [x] Categorized under `LintCategory::Compute`
- [x] UI test fixtures added with expected stderr output (for/while/loop coverage)
- [x] Real SDK test fixtures added
- [x] Integration test updated to verify JSON output
- [x] Documentation created and reference table updated
- [ ] Run `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] Run `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] Run `cargo test --workspace`

commits.message:
feat: add lint for inefficient Bytes concatenation

Adds the soroban_inefficient_bytes_concat lint that detects Bytes
push_back and append calls inside loops. Every Bytes mutation crosses
the Soroban host boundary, making per-iteration calls expensive.

- New lint: SOROBAN_INEFFICIENT_BYTES_CONCAT (warn)
- Detects push_back and append on soroban_sdk::Bytes in loops
- Suggests accumulating in Vec<u8> and converting via Bytes::from_slice
- Test fixtures cover for/while/loop, good patterns, and #[allow]
- Real SDK fixtures and integration test updated

Closes #51
